---
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  version: 1.0.0
  title: OpenAPI 3.1 Webhooks Only
  summary: A valid OAS 3.1 document that omits paths entirely and declares only webhooks
webhooks:
  newPet:
    post:
      operationId: onNewPet
      summary: Webhook fired when a new pet is registered
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: webhook acknowledged
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
components:
  schemas:
    Pet:
      type: object
      required:
        - id
      properties:
        id:
          type: integer
          format: int64
          example: 7
        name:
          type: string
          example: "Rex"

openapi: 3.0.0
info:
  title: concrete before templated
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  # Templated path declared FIRST so declaration-order matching would wrongly select it
  # for "/users/me"; concrete-path precedence must override that.
  /users/{id}:
    get:
      operationId: getUserById
      responses:
        '200':
          description: a user by id
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required:
                  - byId
                properties:
                  byId:
                    type: string
                additionalProperties: false
  /users/me:
    get:
      operationId: getCurrentUser
      responses:
        '200':
          description: the current user
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required:
                  - me
                properties:
                  me:
                    type: string
                additionalProperties: false
